name: voice-bridge
description: Real-time voice translation for two people. English, Hebrew, and Russian. Push-to-talk, cloned voice TTS, phone + browser.

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix apps/mobile
scripts.verify: npm run verify --prefix apps/mobile && npm run verify:regressions --prefix server
scripts.check: npm test && npm run verify && npm run typecheck
